meta.title: Farm Portal — Demo Vet Pharma Co.
meta.description: Enterprise Platform Phase 7 WEB-07 demo — an authenticated farm customer / technical service portal: a real farm’s own orders, technical visits, treatment/feed recommendations and service history, backed by real Frappe session login and per-farm permission scoping.
